summary: Milestone 2026.05.206 ran for 70.3 wall-clock minutes. 6 of 14 tasks completed (43%), 4 tasks blocked (29%), 3 tasks not reached (21%), and 1 retro task (this document). The productive tasks — NRGPT stub, EBRM training, DTM simulation, and TSU parity — all passed cleanly. However, 38% of wall time (27 min of 70 min) was consumed by 12 blocked attempts across 4 tasks, all due to two preventable root causes: missing prior_failures fields (planner discipline violation for 3 tasks) and an upstream artifact schema mismatch that blocked the KAN4CBC cascade. The TSU parity test at 17 minutes was the slowest single task.
bottlenecks_identified: Missing prior_failures fields on 3 tasks (exp2062, exp2063, exp2069) caused 9 doomed-rerun blocks — each retried 3x before giving up. CLAUDE.md mandatory rule violated by planner.
exp2060 artifact schema mismatch: symbolization_ready nested under 'artifact' key, not at top level — caused 3 pre-gate failures for exp2061.
exp2068 TSU parity had a 17-minute wall time with a 14:11 checkpoint stall — likely a tool-use pause or rate-limit; GPU utilization not logged.
exp2064, exp2070, exp2071 never ran — conductor loop interrupted before scheduling these tasks.
improvements_suggested: Planner: add prior_failures block to any task that re-proposes a scope previously blocked/failed. The CLAUDE.md rule is clear; mechanical enforcement should catch violations.
Gate checker: support nested artifact field paths (e.g., 'artifact.symbolization_ready') to prevent false pre-gate blocks from schema nesting.
Add gpu_utilization field to all compute-bound artifacts. Currently 0% of artifacts populate this field, making GPU idle analysis impossible.
Add duration_s to EBRM training artifact (exp2066 missing) to enable timing analysis.
Retire or close exp2063-ebm-cot-latent-calibration: 8 prior failures is the highest count of any recurring task. Either provide a root-cause-addressed proposal or add to exclusion_manifest.yaml.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Fix the gate checker to resolve nested field paths (artifact.symbolization_ready) — this unblocks the entire KAN4CBC cascade without any planner changes.
Add prior_failures blocks to exp2062 (LUT KAN), exp2063 (EBM-CoT), and exp2069 (FR-11 CSL) in next roadmap — or retire exp2063 to the exclusion manifest given 8 prior failures.
Enforce duration_s and gpu_utilization as required fields in compute-bound artifacts — the adversarial verifier's DURATION_TOO_SHORT check is blind without them.
meta_reflection: The milestone's failure mode was structural: three preventable block cascades consumed over a third of total wall time. The planner violated a CLAUDE.md mandatory rule (prior_failures discipline) for 3 of 14 tasks, and the gate checker's field path resolution is too shallow for nested schemas. Both are fixable without research work. The productive core of the milestone — EBRM training, DTM simulation, TSU parity — ran cleanly and moved Phase 3 forward.
